basis: Systemic Streptobacillus infection; inflammatory polyarthritis occurs in ~50% and can persist. Transient rash does not establish skin damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: inflammatory polyarthritis affects ~50% and may persist; this exceeds transient joint pain and supports direct joint involvement.

basis: Epilepsy, intellectual disability, IgA deficiency and congenital fifth-finger shortening define the syndrome; dental abnormalities occur in 30–79%. Conjunctival telangiectasia is non-impairing.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: developmental dental abnormalities affect 30–79%; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: congenital fifth-finger shortening is part of the syndrome's defining phenotype and occurs in 80–99%.

basis: Thiamine-deficiency brain injury causes encephalopathy and amnesia; ophthalmoplegia and nystagmus reflect neurologic dysfunction, not intrinsic eye damage.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: this concept denotes thiamine-deficiency brain injury; its nutritional cause does not itself establish an intrinsic metabolic or endocrine disease.

basis: Congenital motor neuronopathy with defining muscle atrophy and fixed joint contractures; arthrogryposis occurs in 15/20 and scoliosis in 12/20.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: congenital muscle atrophy and fixed contractures define this phenotype; arthrogryposis affects 75% and scoliosis 60%.

basis: The defining cleft directly affects the upper lip and tooth-bearing alveolar bone. Nasal shape abnormalities alone do not establish airway damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: the alveolar ridge is maxillary bone, and its cleft is a defining structural lesion rather than a secondary manifestation.

basis: Inherited iron metabolism disorder; hepatic fibrosis occurs in 80–99%, cardiomyopathy and arthropathy in 30–79% each. Pigmentation alone does not establish skin damage.

decisions.hepatic: involved: iron deposition produces hepatic fibrosis in 80–99%; the defining primary disorder is systemic iron metabolism rather than a liver-specific disease.

basis: Cervical inflammation affects a reproductive organ outside the axes. The umbrella includes infectious and noninfectious causes; inflammation alone does not establish immune-mediated disease.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: infection is a possible cause, not an intrinsic requirement of generic cervicitis; noninfectious cervical inflammation is included.

basis: Relative polycythemia results from dehydration-induced plasma-volume contraction; no intrinsic endocrine, electrolyte or acid-base disorder is established.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: dehydration explains the hemoconcentration; the concept does not establish an additional endocrine, electrolyte, acid-base or intrinsic metabolic disorder.

basis: Thoracic skeletal dysplasia with defining respiratory restriction; renal failure and cataract each occur in 1/1 assessed patient. Evidence is sparse; hepatomegaly alone is insufficient.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: restrictive respiratory insufficiency is a defining component of asphyxiating thoracic dystrophy; a restrictive ventilatory defect is documented in 1/1.

basis: Inherited hepatobiliary transport disorder with cholestasis and portal fibrosis; supplied ancestry explicitly classifies it as an inborn bilirubin metabolism disorder. No extrahepatic damage established.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the supplied ancestry explicitly places this inherited hepatobiliary transport disorder under inborn bilirubin metabolism disorders.
